Trump says Netanyahu 'knows who the boss is' in phone interview

US President Donald Trump has said that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu knows who the boss is, according to a brief phone interview with Axios. The comment comes ahead of possible meetings between the two leaders. The remarks have sparked interest in a potential White House meeting between Trump and Netanyahu.
